definitions.explanation: Being alike or of the same kind. Used to indicate similarity between things.

examples.japanese: ⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同様|どうよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦でした→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The result was the same as last year.

examples.japanese: {同様|どうよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{考|かんが}えています→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{同様|どうよう}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。

notes:
{同様|どうよう} is a formal way to express sameness or similarity. More common in written Japanese and formal speech than in casual conversation.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {同様|どうよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (similarly, likewise)
- Noun modifier: {同様|どうよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧/⟦な→な：09497_na⟧ + noun
- Predicate: {同様|どうよう}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧/⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧ (is the same)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- X⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同様|どうよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: the same as X
- {同様|どうよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧: the same reason
- ～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同様|どうよう}: just like ~
- A⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧B⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同様|どうよう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: A is the same as B (formal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧: same (casual, everyday)
- {同様|どうよう}: same (formal, written)
- ⟦{類似|るいじ}→類似：14672_ruiji⟧: similarity (technical, emphasizes resemblance)
- ⟦{同一|どういつ}→同一：01759_douitsu⟧: identical (strict identity, not just similarity)

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with ⟦{動揺|どうよう}→動揺：03482_douyou⟧ (agitation, being shaken).
